store.description: The 1993 demon-slaying classic, running in the browser through the Internet Archive's DOS emulator. Rip through the Phobos base with a pistol, a shotgun and a chainsaw until the walls stop moving.
features: WASD / arrows to move, Ctrl to fire, Space to open doors
Runs in the Internet Archive's DOS emulator
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
